# INSITOOLS

> INSITOOLS supplies portable on-site machining, welding, valve repair, pipe cutting and hydraulic equipment, with on-site machining services and equipment rental. Headquartered in Singapore (Assurich Industries Pte Ltd) with service teams in Thailand and across ASEAN, backed by 43+ years of industrial equipment distribution and after-sales service.

Contact: sales@assurich.com · +65 6459 1069 · WhatsApp +6598183419 · 9 Tagore Lane #04-28, 9@Tagore, Singapore 787472

## Boring Machines
Portable line boring machines restore worn bores, pin housings and bearing seats in-situ, so heavy equipment, vessels and plant can be repaired where they stand instead of being dismantled and shipped to a workshop.
- [BB40 Portable Boring Machine](https://insitools.com/product/bb40-portable-boring-machine.html)
- [BB50 Portable Boring Machine](https://insitools.com/product/bb50-portable-boring-machine.html)
- [BB60 Portable Boring Machine](https://insitools.com/product/bb60-portable-boring-machine.html)
- [BB80 Portable Boring Machine](https://insitools.com/product/bb80-portable-boring-machine.html)
- [BB100 Heavy Boring Machine](https://insitools.com/product/bb100-heavy-boring-machine.html)
- [BB120 Heavy Boring Machine](https://insitools.com/product/bb120-heavy-boring-machine.html)
- [BB160 Ultra Boring Machine](https://insitools.com/product/bb160-ultra-boring-machine.html)
- [BB200 Industrial Boring Machine](https://insitools.com/product/bb200-industrial-boring-machine.html)
- [PB 800BL/90 Portable Boring Machine](https://insitools.com/product/pb-800bl-90-portable-boring-machine.html)
- [On-Site Lathe Machine](https://insitools.com/product/on-site-lathe-machine.html)

## Milling Machines
Portable and gantry milling machines bolt directly onto large components to machine flat surfaces, keyways and mounting pads on site with workshop-level accuracy.
- [Gantry Milling Machine GM-1000](https://insitools.com/product/gantry-milling-machine-gm-1000.html)
- [Gantry Milling Machine GM-2000](https://insitools.com/product/gantry-milling-machine-gm-2000.html)
- [Gantry Milling Machine GM-3000](https://insitools.com/product/gantry-milling-machine-gm-3000.html)
- [Gantry Milling Machine GM-4000](https://insitools.com/product/gantry-milling-machine-gm-4000.html)
- [Gantry Milling Machine GM-5000](https://insitools.com/product/gantry-milling-machine-gm-5000.html)

## Bore Welders
Automatic bore welders build up worn bores and faces with a controlled weld overlay, so the bore can then be line-bored back to its original size on site.
- [BW350 Automated Bore Welder](https://insitools.com/product/bw350-automated-bore-welder.html)
- [ABW 350/360 Bore Welder](https://insitools.com/product/abw-350-360-bore-welder.html)
- [Automated Welder BW-600](https://insitools.com/product/automated-welder-bw-600.html)
- [Heavy Bore Welder BW-450](https://insitools.com/product/heavy-bore-welder-bw-450.html)

## Valve Solution
In-situ valve grinding and lapping machines restore the sealing seats of gate, globe and safety valves without removing the valve from the line.
- [In-Situ Gate Valve Lapping Machine GV-50](https://insitools.com/product/in-situ-gate-valve-lapping-machine-gv-50.html)
- [In-Situ Globe Valve (Flat Seat) Grinding & Lapping Machine GL-80](https://insitools.com/product/in-situ-globe-valve-flat-seat-grinding-lapping-machine-gl-80.html)
- [Valve Lapping/Grinding Machines GV-50](https://insitools.com/product/valve-lapping-grinding-machines-gv-50.html)
- [Enclosed Wedge Lapping Cabinet WL-100/400-E](https://insitools.com/product/enclosed-wedge-lapping-cabinet-wl-100-400-e.html)

## Pipe Cutting
Split-frame and clamshell pipe cutters cold-cut and bevel in-line pipe for weld preparation, without heat, sparks or the need to remove the pipe.
- [Portable Plate Bevel Machine](https://insitools.com/product/portable-plate-bevel-machine.html)
- [Pipe Cold Cutting & Bevel Machine CP-20](https://insitools.com/product/pipe-cold-cutting-bevel-machine-cp-20.html)
- [Clamshell Pipe Cutters CP-20](https://insitools.com/product/clamshell-pipe-cutters-cp-20.html)
- [Tube Expanders & Bevelers](https://insitools.com/product/tube-expanders-bevelers.html)

## Flange Facers
Portable flange facing machines re-machine flange sealing faces, gasket grooves and heat-exchanger faces on site, restoring a leak-free seal without removing the pipe, vessel or valve.
- [Flange Facing Machine PFF-500](https://insitools.com/product/flange-facing-machine-pff-500.html)
- [Mini Flange Facer PFF-25](https://insitools.com/product/mini-flange-facer-pff-25.html)
- [Flange Facer PFF-25](https://insitools.com/product/flange-facer-pff-25.html)
- [Flange Facer PFF-150/610](https://insitools.com/product/flange-facer-pff-150-610.html)
- [Flange Facer PFF-150/1000](https://insitools.com/product/flange-facer-pff-150-1000.html)
- [Heavy Flange Facer PFF-500](https://insitools.com/product/heavy-flange-facer-pff-500.html)

## Hydraulic Tools
High-pressure hydraulic tools – power units, torque wrenches, pumps and cylinders – provide controlled force for bolting, lifting and maintenance work in the field.
- [Torque Wrench Pump TP-700](https://insitools.com/product/torque-wrench-pump-tp-700.html)
- [High Flow Electric Hydraulic Power Unit HP-700](https://insitools.com/product/high-flow-electric-hydraulic-power-unit-hp-700.html)
- [Hydraulic Torque Wrenches TW-72](https://insitools.com/product/hydraulic-torque-wrenches-tw-72.html)
